title: S3Location
description: A location in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) where SimSpace Weaver stores simulation data, such as your app .zip files and schema file. For more information about Amazon S3, see the Amazon Simple Storage Service User Guide .

allOf.description: The name of an Amazon S3 bucket. For more information about buckets, see Creating, configuring, and working with Amazon S3 buckets in the Amazon Simple Storage Service User Guide.

The key name of an object in Amazon S3. For more information about Amazon S3 objects and object keys, see Uploading, downloading, and working with objects in Amazon S3 in the Amazon Simple Storage Service User Guide.
